## Checks

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run test:coverage` pass
- [ ] Tests are added or changed for this change, or this description says why none are needed
- [ ] For map or interface changes, the Playwright specs that cover the change pass (`npm run test:e2e -w @mapcairn/web -- <spec name>`), and so do the full `npm run e2e` and `npm run a11y` when the change is to layout, the map engine, the test seam or a component's colour, focus or semantics
- [ ] I have agreed to [`CLA.md`](../CLA.md) in a comment on this or an earlier pull request
- [ ] Copy is in British English, and the README and docs are updated for the change, or this description says why none needed it
- [ ] Anything the change sends over the network is in `PRIVACY.md` and the privacy page
